summary: Stage 1 prefills the Initiator's first and last name from the signed-in viewer's own name — `user_profile.display_name` when they have saved a profile, else the name the auth provider holds — and hands them down as editable field defaults.
reader_impact: A signed-in member starting a relationship sees their own name already in the two Initiator fields and can type over it; a visitor's form is unchanged and draws empty fields.
